logout.title: Ka bax?
logout.description: Waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad mar kale gasho si aad app-ka u isticmaasho.
logout.pending: {count, plural, one {# diiwaan ka-qaybgal ah ayaa} other {# diiwaan ka-qaybgal ah ayaa}} ku keydsan qalabkan weli lama dirin. Ku xidh internetka oo ha isku waafaqo intaadan ka bixin.

deactivate.title: Joojin {name}?
deactivate.description: {name} ma geli karo ilaa aad xisaabta mar kale hawlgeliso. Waxba lama tirtirayo.

withdraw.title: Ka laabo codsigan?
withdraw.description: Maamuluhu mar dambe ma arki doono. Codsi cusub ayaad dib u soo dirsan kartaa.

discardAttendance.title: Iska tuur ka-qaybgalka aan la keydin?
discardAttendance.description: Calaamado qaarkood weli lama keydin. Haddii aad sii wadato way luminayaan.

bulkMarks.title: Beddel calaamadaha?
bulkMarks.description: {count, plural, one {# arday oo hore calaamad kale u lahaa} other {# arday oo hore calaamad kale u lahaa}} waxaa loo beddelayaa "{status}". Waxba lama keydinayo ilaa aad riixdo Keydi.

clearMarks.title: Nadiifi dhammaan calaamadaha?
clearMarks.description: Dhammaan {count} calaamadood ee xaashidan waa la saari doonaa. Ka-qaybgalka hore loo keydiyay wuu sii jiri doonaa ilaa aad mar kale keydiso.

closeRegistration.title: Xidh diiwaangelinta ardayda?
closeRegistration.description: Ustaasyadu ma ku dari karaan arday cusub ilaa aad diiwaangelinta mar kale furto.

platformLists.title: Keydi liisaska dhammaan madrasadaha?
platformLists.description: Madrasad kasta oo isticmaasha liisaska guud wuxuu doorashooyinkan ku arki doonaa foomamkiisa isla markiiba.

usePlatformLists.title: U isticmaal liisaska guud {name}?
usePlatformLists.description: Liisaska {name} wax ka beddeshay waa la dhigayaa dhinac, waxaana isticmaalayaa liisaska guud. Liisaskiisa gaarka ah dib ayaad u oggolaan kartaa.

removeLogo.title: Ka saar astaanta?
removeLogo.description: Astaanta caadiga ah ayaa loo isticmaalayaa bogga gelitaanka iyo calaamadda app-ka ilaa aad mid cusub soo geliso.

discardForm.title: Iska tuur foomkan?
discardForm.description: Waxa aad qortay lama keydin oo way luminayaan.

saveAttendance.title: Keydi ka-qaybgalka?
saveAttendance.description: Ka-qaybgalka {className} ee {date} waxaa loo diiwaangelinayaa {count, plural, one {# arday} other {# arday}}. Dabadeed waad sixi kartaa.
saveAttendance.pastDay: Kani maaha ka-qaybgalka maanta: waxaad keydinaysaa {date}.
saveAttendance.unmarked: {count, plural, one {# arday calaamad ma leh lamana diiwaangelin doono.} other {# arday calaamad ma laha lamana diiwaangelin doonaan.}}
saveAttendance.smsNext: Marka xigta waxaa lagu weydiin doonaa inaad waalidka ardayda maqan u dirto SMS.
